newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat-Heavy snows hit Kansas, Colorado.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat-Heavy snows hit Kansas, Colorado.

text.p: Much-needed precipitation in the form of heavy snow fell Sunday and Monday in western Kansas and eastern Colorado, grain merchandisers in the High Plains said.
A dealer in western Kansas said Colby had received about 12 inches of snow by Monday morning, but that the snow had mostly tapered off. Stockton, Kan, was said to have received at least eight inches.
Meanwhile, dealers had different opinions on the pace of hard red winter wheat sales following the rally in KCBT wheat futures.

"It seems like we've been buying quite a bit of wheat. The main thing we're buying is new crop corn, but the wheat's started to follow that and most of it is new crop," a south central Kansas dealer said.
But another central Kansas dealer said he had only seen limited new sales of wheat last week.
"We really haven't bought much grain since the 11th," the Kansas dealer said.
An Oklahoma merchandiser said he had seen "moderate" movement last week.
